Also: 'You're in complete control of choosing what hourly rate you charge... As an example, a Cleaning Professional charging $25/hr and working 10 jobs/week will earn $3,500-$4,000 per month. Most Cleaning Professionals average 2-3 jobs for each day, and are tipped anywhere between $5 and $20 per job.' Instant Pay available on some jobs.
timing: Weekly direct deposit processed every Monday (<4 days to land); Instant Pay on some jobs.
eligibility: Smartphone with the Homeaglow for Cleaners app
Your own cleaning supplies/transportation (varies by market)
steps: Apply as a Cleaning Professional on Homeaglow
Pass background check and set your own hourly rate
Claim cleaning appointments in the app
Complete the clean and charge the client through your dashboard
Get paid via weekly Monday direct deposit (or Instant Pay where offered)
catches: You set your rate — pricing too high means no bookings, too low means grinding
Instant Pay is NOT available on every job; weekly is the default
2-3 jobs a day is the norm, so income depends on keeping your schedule full
1099 contractor: supplies, transport, and taxes are on you
Bad reviews tank your booking rate fast
biggest_catch: Weekly pay is the default and Instant Pay only exists on some jobs — so even though you control your rate, you still wait days to a week for the money unless you land an Instant Pay job.
upfront_fee: $0 official signup; background check included in onboarding.

weasel_words.quote: '$3,500-$4,000 per month' example assumes 10 jobs/week at $25/hr — an idealized schedule, not a guarantee.

repeatable.cadence: Claim cleaning appointments, finish each clean, and invoice through your dashboard — stack 2–3 jobs a day for weekly Monday payouts, repeatable as long as bookings keep coming.

maximize: Set your opening rate slightly below the going rate to win first bookings, then raise it once reviews stack up; stack 2-3 jobs a day back-to-back in the same neighborhood to kill unpaid travel; chase Instant Pay jobs when cash is tight; ask happy clients for 5-star reviews immediately after the clean since ratings drive your booking rate; bring your own preferred supplies to finish faster and earn more per hour.
who_pays: Homeaglow pays you by direct deposit — you charge the client through your dashboard after each clean, but the money reaches you through Homeaglow: every Monday by default, or instantly on the jobs where Instant Pay is offered.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older with real cleaning experience and professional standards, pass a background check, use the Homeaglow for Cleaners app on your smartphone, and provide your own cleaning supplies and transportation (varies by market).
work_available: You claim appointments in the app, and most cleaners average 2–3 jobs a day — your income depends entirely on keeping your schedule full, and bad reviews quickly dry up your bookings. Demand varies by metro.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid for completed cleaning appointments invoiced through your dashboard. Your ratings decide how many bookings you win — bad reviews tank your booking rate. Homeaglow's specific non-payment triggers and removal policy are not publicly stated.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Signup and the background check are officially free. Everything else is on you: cleaning supplies, transportation, and self-employment taxes. Unpaid time: the application process, gaps between jobs, and travel between clients.
when_cash_arrives: Direct deposit processed every Monday, landing in your bank within about 4 days. Instant Pay exists on some jobs for faster access, but weekly is the default — plan your cash flow around it.
